messages:
ellie-finance: Heads up 9 customers in today's finalize batch show vendor pass-through fees missing from rendered invoices. totals off by vendor_fee amounts and a few customers got duplicate invoices (one with fee, one without). sending example.

dan-engineering: example ids please?

ellie-finance: INV-MP-2024-7711 / cust-mp-907. Customer received INV-MP-2024-7711 (vendor_fee=0) and INV-MP-2024-7711-dup (vendor_fee=1800). Ledger shows vendor_fee applied; pdf mismatch.

billing-bot: finalize_batch:marketplace_202406 completed 2532109800 status=SUCCESS invoices_finalized=11240 duplicates_emitted=9

marketplace-bot: deploy marketplace-fees-service:v2.3 completed 2532109600 by ci-pipeline (permissions change: renderer-service account role trimmed)

dan-engineering: quick triage: renderer reads vendor fees from marketplace-fees-service via service account. recent RBAC change for least-privilege removed read access to fees table for renderer-service -> service returned empty fees -> renderer defaulted missing vendor_fee to 0. duplicate invoices due to finalize retry picking up refreshed perm cache on a second worker.

sara-support: seeing ~12 tickets now, some customers paid the higher invoice. need pause on outbound emails and payouts for affected cohort.

ops-sre: can you confirm the RBAC change timestamp?

marketplace-bot: RBAC-change recorded at 2532109555 (commit rbac-trim-2024-06) author=infra-admin

dan-engineering: reproducer locally: 
```
# pseudo
fees = fees_service.get_fees(customer_id)  # returns [] on 403
if not fees:
  vendor_fee_amount = 0  # bad default
emit_invoice(vendor_fee_amount)
# concurrent retry after role cache refresh -> fees present -> emits another invoice with fee -> -dup appended
```

ellie-finance: we need a fast mitigation plan. finance requests re-finalize + credit memos for overcharged payments.

dan-engineering: mitigation steps: 1) restore temporary read permission for renderer-service immediately, 2) patch renderer to fallback to direct DB read when fees_service returns empty on 403/5xx, 3) add idempotency lock on canonical_order_id to prevent duplicates, 4) alert if vendor_fee_count_mismatch > 0. I'll push fixes now.

ops-sre: restoring renderer-service read role now (actioned at 2532109850).

billing-bot: re_finalize_job queued for marketplace_202406 by dan-engineering at 2532109875

sara-support: holding outbound messaging. draft comms: "We've detected inconsistent invoice previews for a small set of marketplace customers caused by an internal permission change. We're reissuing corrected invoices and will issue credits/refunds where applicable." sending for finance/legal review.

legal: please make sure template avoids admitting systemic negligence; stick to neutral language. send to finance for signoff.

dan-engineering: hotfix pushed at 2532109922: DB fallback for fees_service miss + idempotency lock. adding metric fees_service_403_rate and vendor_fee_render_mismatch.

billing-bot: re_finalize_job started 2532109930 status=IN_PROGRESS items=9

billing-bot: re_finalize_job completed 2532109988 status=SUCCESS duplicates_voided=9 vendor_lines_restored=19 credits_issued=7 refunds_initiated=2

ellie-finance: ran diffs on affected invoices; vendor fee lines now match ledger. preparing customer outreach list and credit memos.

sara-support: sending prioritized messages to customers who paid the higher amount. finance approved neutral template.

ops-sre: postmortem actions: 1) add RBAC rollout checklist that includes renderer-role smoke check, 2) renderer: DB fallback + idempotency + alerting, 3) add pre-finalize preview count vs expected sanity check.

dan-engineering: leaving log snippets for the postmortem: 
```
ERROR renderer: fees_service returned 403 for cust-mp-907 at 2532109832; defaulted vendor_fee=0
WARN finalize: duplicate finalize detected for order ord-mp-701 -> emitted INV-MP-2024-7711-dup at 2532109858
```

ellie-finance: incident ticket being created with timeline, diffs and affected invoice ids. closing thread for now 44B
